canonical_name: Cybersecurity Strategy Not Adjusted Based on Requirements
description: The cybersecurity risk management strategy is not adjusted based on outcomes.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify organizations with static cybersecurity strategies that are not updated, lack of documented strategy revision processes, strategies not aligned with current organizational requirements or risk landscape, or absence of gap analysis to identify coverage deficiencies.
